title: layout file
description: A design's layout.yml in the form layout/v2, as e-designer writes it: a Resource (ADR-S15) holding, for each view the design draws, the place of every box it draws and, for a view drawn as a hexagon, of every block on it, so the board draws what is kept and works out no place. A place nobody gave is worked out once, by e-designer, when a write leaves a box without one. The form before it, layout/v1, is the bare file holding version 2 or 3 and views, which may leave boxes without a place; its upgrade is the layout step of the project migration (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml). Not a design change: no resource file holds a place.

apiVersion.description: The form the file is in, so a reader knows which schema it meets (ADR-S15, apiversion/v1/forms.yaml).

kind.description: Always Layout, the kind of this file.

id.description: The design's id, the folder the file sits in, so a layout is never filed under another design.

spec.description: Where things sit on the board, view by view.

views.description: One page per view, keyed by its name in design.yml; a design that declares no views keeps its one page under default.

additionalProperties.description: One view's places: its boxes, its lines and its hexagon, each left out when it holds nothing.

boxes.description: Every box the view draws, by id, at its place on the board, so the board draws it there and a drag moves only the box dragged.

additionalProperties.description: One box's place, and its size only where a person resized it.

x.description: Across the board, in canvas units, so the board draws it there.

y.description: Down the board, in canvas units, so the board draws it there.

w.description: The width a person gave the box, so it is drawn at it; absent, the board sizes it by its content.

h.description: The height a person gave the box, so it is drawn at it; absent, the board sizes it by its content.

lines.description: Lines a person shaped, by Link id, so the board draws them as shaped; a line nobody shaped is left out and follows its boxes.

additionalProperties.description: One line's shape in this view.

bends.description: The corners it runs through, in order, so it keeps the route a person gave it.

x.description: Across the board, in canvas units, so the board draws it there.

y.description: Down the board, in canvas units, so the board draws it there.

badge.description: Where a person put the line's badge, so it stays there as the line moves: how far along the line by length, and how far off it.

along.description: How far along the line, from 0 to 1, so the badge travels with the line.

dx.description: How far off the line, across, in canvas units.

dy.description: How far off the line, down, in canvas units.

sides.description: The sides it leaves and meets its boxes by in this view, as <from>-<to>, so it keeps the sides a person chose; its Link's own sides win.

hexagon.description: Every block on the view's hexagon, by id, at its place, when the view is drawn as a hexagon, so the board draws the hexagon as kept; absent when it is not.

additionalProperties.description: One block's place on the hexagon, on the board.

x.description: Across the board, in canvas units, so the board draws it there.

y.description: Down the board, in canvas units, so the board draws it there.
